checks: b, s, t_min non-decreasing with size within R series (8 rows) and within M series (16 rows)
t_min < b for every row (socket depth smaller than plug length: 4<8, 5<10, 6<12, 7.5<15, 11.5<18/20)
socket width s is smaller than the thread major diameter for every M row (M8 4<8 ... M42 22<42)

R rows carry identical (b,s,t) to the M rows at the same series step (R1/8=M10, R1/4=M14, R3/8=M16/M18, R1/2=M20/M22, R3/4=M24-M27, R1=M30/M33, R1 1/4=M42, R1 1/2=M48): consistent in torqbolt, Fuller and the German dataset
s values 4,5,6,7,8,10,12,17,19,22,24,32 are standard hex-key (ISO 4762 / DIN 911) sizes
shape_hint: Headless plug: a plain cylinder of length b fully threaded with a slightly tapered (conical) external thread, flat end face with a small chamfer, and a hexagon socket (width across flats s, depth t) recessed in the large end. No head, no collar; seals by taper thread (usually with sealant).

role_map.d: thread designation (R = tapered pipe thread ISO 7-1; Mxp = metric tapered DIN 158-1)
role_map.b: plug/thread length (also total length), tolerance js16
role_map.s: hex socket width across flats, nominal (tol D12)

notes: Rows are labelled with pitch inside the label (M10x1 etc.) and R pipe rows have no pitch column because R-thread pitch (TPI) is not in these sources. R rows and M rows share the same dimension grid; pairings between R and M sizes differ between sources (Ganter pairs R1/4 with M14, torqbolt with M12/M14), so no R<->M equivalence is asserted. R1 support relies on torqbolt's row whose label is truncated to 'DIN 906 R' (sits between R3/4 and R1 1/4 and its dims equal R1). Sizes with two series pitches (M30, M36, M42 also P=2) use the finer pitch row. 'b' is the thread length per DIN 906 'short thread' and equals overall length. Tapered NPT variants (DIN 906 NPT, ASME) are a different family (plugnpt). Fasenco lists M14 s=4 (typo; 7 per 4 other sources) - its M14 row not counted.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched all 5 listed URLs live plus fasteners.eu DIN 906 (extra, HTTP 200). Parsed torqbolt (3 label columns M-pitch1 / M-pitch2 / R, then l, e, s, s min/max, t1), Fuller (8 transposed tables incl. decoded date-garbled R labels), lexikon (s,t min,b per size incl. explicit R rows), fasenco (M8..M36), Ganter (M row paired with R row: h, A/F), fasteners.eu. 24 rows x 3 cols = 72 cells. Cluster counts per cell without the extra source: b 4-5 (R rows: F,G,L,T), s 4-5 (M14 s: fasenco typo 4 out-voted), t_min 3-4 (R rows and M38/M42: F,L,T only; Ganter has no t). With fasteners.eu every cell has +1 and all agree. Zero numeric dissent except fasenco M14 s=4. Physical: b,s,t non-decreasing within R series and M series, t<b, s<d; R rows carry the same (b,s,t) as the M row they are paired with in torqbolt/Fuller/fasteners.eu (R1/8=M10, R1/4=M14 own row, R3/8=M16/M18, R1/2=M20/M22, R3/4=M24-M27, R1=M30/M33, R1 1/4=M42, R1 1/2=M48).
problems: Mixed thread families in one `d` key: labels are unambiguous (R rows have no 'x' and no pitch; M rows always MxP) but `d` must be treated as a designation string, not a number; R rows have no pitch.

R-row evidence is partly decoded: Fuller R labels are Excel-date garbled ('8-Jan'=R1/8, '4-Jan'=R1/4, '8-Mar'=R3/8, '2-Jan'=R1/2, '4-Mar'=R3/4; R1 is plain '1'). Decode is unambiguous and cross-validated by explicit labels in torqbolt/lexikon/fasteners.eu, but it is an inference.

R1: torqbolt label is truncated to 'DIN 906 R' (assigned to R1 by sequence only). Explicit R1 labels exist in Fuller ('1'), lexikon ('R 1'), Ganter ('R 1'), fasteners.eu ('R1'). So R1 t_min has explicit support only from Fuller+lexikon (+fasteners.eu extra); b,s are fine (4 explicit). Recommend adding the fasteners.eu URL to sources.
Symbol for plug length differs by site (torqbolt/Fuller 'l/L js16', lexikon/fasenco/fasteners.eu 'b', Ganter 'h'); same value in every row (headless plug: thread length = overall length).
M30x1.5/M36x1.5/M42x1.5 also exist as x2 with identical b,s,t (fasenco lists M30x2 only); fine because pitch is in the label.
fasteners.eu additionally supports rows M45, M48, M52 (b,s,t) - not added.
